tasks.title: Conversation #57
tasks.transcript:
Woman: What do you know about this rock festival that's happening?
Man: Not much. Do you know what time it starts?
Woman: It kicks off at 3:00 PM.
Man: That's perfect. Oh, I remember hearing that. There will be food trucks.
Woman: Oh, right. And a dance floor.
Man: No way. You can't keep us away. Let's get there early so we can get a good spot.

questions.stem: What event are the speakers discussing?

options.B: A performance by a famous dancer

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：他们在讨论什么活动？ 定位原文：rock festival 选项分析： A. 卡车展。错误。 B. 舞蹈表演。错误。 C. 餐厅开业。错误。 D. 音乐节。直接对应，因此正确。

questions.stem: How does the man feel about the event?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：男生对这个活动的态度？ 定位原文：You can't keep us away 选项分析： A. 好奇。一般。 B. 兴奋。语气强烈，因此正确。 C. 希望。弱。 D. 失望。错误。
